software_engineer.name: Software Engineer
software_engineer.description: Designs, builds, and maintains software systems and applications, turning requirements into reliable, scalable code.

devops_engineer.name: DevOps Engineer
devops_engineer.description: Automates infrastructure, builds CI/CD pipelines, and keeps systems deployable, observable, and secure.

data_scientist.name: Data Scientist
data_scientist.description: Finds patterns in data and builds models that turn raw numbers into predictions and decisions.

ux_designer.name: UX Designer
ux_designer.description: Shapes how products feel to use — research, wireframes, and visual design that make experiences intuitive.

product_manager.name: Product Manager
product_manager.description: Owns the what and why of a product — sets priorities, aligns teams, and ships things people want.

financial_analyst.name: Financial Analyst
financial_analyst.description: Models the numbers behind decisions — forecasts, valuations, and the story the data tells about money.

marketing_specialist.name: Marketing Specialist
marketing_specialist.description: Gets the right message to the right people — campaigns, content, and channels that drive growth.

hr_coordinator.name: HR Coordinator
hr_coordinator.description: Keeps the people side of a company running — hiring, onboarding, and the policies that hold teams together.

sales_representative.name: Sales Representative
sales_representative.description: Turns prospects into customers — builds relationships, understands needs, and closes deals.

customer_service_manager.name: Customer Service Manager
customer_service_manager.description: Leads the team that keeps customers happy — resolves issues, sets standards, and turns support into loyalty.
